title: RLPolicy RobotPickPlaceComparison

stats.done_summary: Completed policy comparison analysis for pi_new vs pi_base pick-and-place robotics policies. Analysis of 8 metrics across simulation and real-world environments revealed that pi_new improves 5 metrics (success rate +2.5%, cycle time -11%, collision count -10.5%, energy -7.7%, human rating +2.6%) but degrades 3 safety-critical metrics (safety intervention rate +244%, edge case failure rate +86.5%, line stop events +60%). Generated 6 visualizations and comprehensive report with CONDITIONAL DEPLOYMENT recommendation - advising phased deployment with enhanced safety monitoring or continued development to address safety deficiencies before production deployment.
